newsitem.title: USA: Maxam Gold to acquire claims from Uranco.
newsitem.headline: Maxam Gold to acquire claims from Uranco.

text.p: Maxam Gold Corp said Friday it signed a letter of intent to buy 63 claims, or 10,080 acres from the Coyote Peak claim block in Arizona owned by Uranco Mining LLC.
Maxam said it also obtained the right of first refusal to Uranco's remaining 58 claims, which include 9,280 acres in the southern half of the Coyote Peak block.
Maxam said it will provide 630,000 restricted common shares in addition to warrants that will be exercised in five years.
Maxam shares closed down 11/16 Friday at 2-3/8.
